name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should build a lightweight "prompt health" dashboard that flags stale or low-quality prompts in real time.

Why: A dashboard lets us spot weak prompts before users complain, and it’s cheaper than rewriting everything blindly. It also gives us a single place to track which prompts actually matter, so we don’t waste effort on ones nobody uses.

Trade-off: We’re adding another tool to maintain, but the upkeep is tiny compared to the risk of letting bad prompts linger and confuse users.
